prompt.zh-TW: 速達機車行向零件商賒購一批輪胎與機油，共 {{money:e1.amount}}，約定下個月付款。這筆交易之後，下面四個數字各會怎麼變？
prompt.en: Swift Scooter Repairs buys tyres and engine oil worth {{money:e1.amount}} from a parts dealer on credit, payable next month. After this transaction, how does each of the four figures below change?

explanation.zh-TW: 存貨增加 {{money:e1.amount}}，應付帳款也增加同樣的金額。東西還沒賣出去，所以稅前淨利不變；錢也還沒付，所以{{term:tm_e61ht6yh}}不變。間接法裡「{{term:tm_bpt2kp5c}}」的減項和「{{term:tm_dc0p0nrv}}」的加項剛好互相抵銷。
explanation.en: Inventories rise by {{money:e1.amount}} and trade payables rise by the same amount. Nothing has been sold yet, so profit before tax is unchanged; nothing has been paid yet, so {{term:tm_e61ht6yh}} is unchanged too. In the indirect method the deduction on the {{term:tm_bpt2kp5c}} line and the addition on the {{term:tm_dc0p0nrv}} line cancel each other out.
